warn_detail: The single-component head enhancement hook adds alpha*d_{e,L} (full residual direction) to the layer output, not a head-specific projection. This makes Stage-B head scores equivalent across heads within the same layer. Stage-A (probe AUC) remains head-specific. The Jaccard stability computation uses Stage-A signals, so the Jaccard result is unaffected.
slot_A_note: Stage B uses fixed alpha=1.0 for selection; M2 runs alpha in {0.5,1.0,2.0} sweep for causal predicates. Expected partial for M1.
